svg.title: A two-system VLA and the course stack
svg.desc: Two columns. Column 1, a two-system VLA: a blue box, slow model, a VLM with 7B parameters at 7 to 9 Hz; below it a dashed empty amber box reading no executive; below that a green box, fast policy with 80M parameters at 200 Hz; then the robot. The arrow from the slow model goes straight to the fast policy, past the empty box. Column 2, the course stack: a blue box with the PDDL planner (GP3) and the LLM agent (GP4); an amber box, the behavior tree (GP1), which checks every result; a green box with the skills, MoveIt 2 and the controllers; then the robot.
